team.name: Daniel Picou
bio: Daniel Picou, Founder and CEO of THREE, is a visionary leader with a proven track record in the global marketplace. Renowned for his strategic acumen and deep understanding of market dynamics, Picou has successfully guided companies by staying ahead of trends and prioritizing the needs of customers. His belief in the limitless potential of people drives his mission to inspire entrepreneurs toward meaningful, lasting success. Picou first made his mark in digital marketing before co-founding and leading a direct selling company that operated across 12 international markets. Over the years, his guidance and leadership have helped businesses expand their reach and capture significant market share. With a passion for science-backed innovation and a commitment to building a purpose-driven community, Picou launched THREE in early 2023. His leadership has positioned the company as a standout in the direct selling industry by merging cutting-edge, science-based products with a platform for personal and professional growth. His personal philosophy, "Create a vision and never let the environment, other people’s beliefs, or the limits of the past shape your decisions", has fueled his success and continues to guide THREE’s mission to redefine what’s possible.

team.name: Dr. Dan Gubler, Ph.D.
bio: Known affectionately as “Dr. Dan,” Dr. Dan Gubler is a renowned phytonutrient chemist and Caltech-trained scientist serving as Chief Scientific Officer at THREE. With over 16 patents and more than 70 successful nutritional supplement formulations, Dr. Dan’s groundbreaking work in bioactive compounds has transformed lives around the world. His expertise in harnessing the power of plants to improve human health has established him as a leading figure in the field of natural health solutions. Throughout his career, Dr. Dan has been honored with prestigious awards, including the DSA Visionary Award and the Schering-Plough Science and Innovation Award. He has spoken at over 150 events across 40 countries, sharing his knowledge with global audiences. His passion for scientific discovery and innovation is reflected in his role at THREE, where he formulates cutting-edge products designed to empower health and wellness. As the host of Discover with Dr. Dan: The Proactive Health Podcast and a social media influencer with over 330,000 followers, Dr. Dan continues to educate and inspire. He holds a Ph.D. in organic chemistry from Colorado State University and a B.Sc. in biochemistry from Brigham Young University. A passionate advocate for the transformative power of direct selling, Dr. Dan is dedicated to advancing THREE’s mission to deliver exceptional health solutions worldwide.

team.name: Troy Mohr
bio: Troy Mohr, Chief Operating Officer at THREE, leads the company’s Global Operations with more than 30 years of experience in both operations and manufacturing. His expertise spans a wide range of industries and markets, allowing him to drive operational efficiency and global alignment. Known for spearheading cultural and operational transformations, Mohr excels in developing strategies that not only enhance performance but also foster a synergistic and inclusive workplace culture. Mohr’s leadership is characterized by his ability to build high-performing teams focused on innovation and consistent results. His commitment to process optimization and his forward-thinking approach have made him a trusted leader in operations management, both in the private and public sectors. At THREE, Mohr’s primary focus is serving the Brand Ambassadors and Customers who are at the heart of the company’s mission. He believes the greatest asset lies in the people who trust and contribute to the brand’s success. Mohr holds an MBA from The University of Chicago Booth School of Business and a bachelor’s degree in business administration from Lewis University, bringing both academic and practical expertise to his role.

team.name: Anne Larson
bio: As Vice President of Global Finance at THREE, Anne Larson oversees the company’s corporate and international financial operations, ensuring its financial health and strategic growth. With over 15 years of experience in the direct sales industry, she brings a comprehensive approach to global business strategy. Prior to entering the direct sales industry, Larson spent four years at KPMG, where she honed her skills in financial analysis, compliance, and risk management. She has since led corporate and international finance teams, excelling at building high-performing teams that foster growth and operational efficiency. Larson also holds a Bachelor of Science in Accounting & Business Management from the University of Wisconsin and a Master of Professional Accountancy from Weber State University. She is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) and a Chartered Global Management Accountant (CGMA). Driven by the opportunity to create meaningful impact, Larson is dedicated to mentoring and growing her teams while implementing innovative financial strategies for long-term success. Outside of work, she enjoys running and supporting her youngest child in various sports activities.

team.name: Janea Janke
bio: With over 25 years of leadership in the direct selling industry, Janea Janke drives THREE International’s customer support strategy. She leads the global team with a focus on delivering exceptional service and seamless experiences for every customer. Known for her hands-on approach, Janea excels in refining processes, mentoring teams, and creating efficient, results-driven operations. A graduate of Southern Utah University and Dixie College, Janea’s career is built on a commitment to leading by example. Outside of work, she enjoys photography, films, and supporting her children in sports, her ultimate passion. Janea is inspired by THREE’s mission to unlock human potential, and she is dedicated to advancing the company's purpose of empowering people to live more significant lives.

team.name: Keith Tang
bio: Keith Tang serves as Director of Asia Pacific at THREE, where he leads operations across the region with a focus on sustainable growth, compliance, and empowering the Brand Ambassador network. With over 15 years of experience in the networking industry, including more than a decade in senior leadership roles, Keith brings a deep understanding of field dynamics and a strong track record of building high-performing distributor networks. A graduate of the University of the West of England with a degree in Law, Keith also holds certifications as a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) and Certified Estate Planner. He is known for his people-first, results-driven leadership style and his ability to inspire teams through accountability, integrity, and collaboration. His career highlights include launching and scaling multiple international markets, driving revenue growth, and enhancing distributor engagement through innovative training and incentives. Outside of work, Keith enjoys traveling and exploring new cultures, experiences that continue to inform his global perspective. He is deeply motivated by the opportunity to help individuals create lasting success and legacy, and he is proud to be part of THREE’s mission to change lives through wellness and entrepreneurship.

team.name: Tommy Chan
bio: With over two decades of experience in the direct selling industry across Hong Kong and Greater China, Tommy Chan brings deep operational expertise and strategic leadership to his role as General Manager at THREE. He has overseen multi-billion-dollar annual sales and played a key role in building market infrastructures from the ground up, defining and refining SOPs, aligning compliance, and developing highly effective teams across departments. Tommy is known for his ability to navigate complex markets with clarity and confidence. His strengths lie in strategic planning, staff development, and cross-functional coordination, ensuring that every facet of the business runs with precision. He is passionate about cultivating growth through vision-driven leadership, and has a proven history of launching successful market strategies that drive performance and engagement. What drew Tommy to THREE was a rare alignment of purpose, product, and people. Inspired by the company’s leadership and vision, he recognized in THREE a once-in-a-generation opportunity: a powerful wellness brand built on innovation, integrity, and an unmatched commitment to quality. He is honored to help lead that vision forward in Greater China.

board.name: Dr. Dan Gubler
bio: Dr. Dan Gubler, Ph.D., is a Caltech-trained phytonutrient chemist, and former professor who has traveled to every continent discovering and researching bioactive compounds in plants and using them to help others. An expert on how natural molecules from plants can dramatically improve human health, Dr. Gubler has 16 patents granted or pending and has developed 70 nutritional supplements that gross $500 million in annual sales. Over the course of his career, Dr. Gubler has been recognized with the DSA Visionary Award, the Schering-Plough Science and Innovation Award, the American Cancer Society Fellowship, the Eli Lilly Fellowship, and the Best Educator Award from Brigham Young University–Hawaii. He has also been inducted into the London Speaker Bureau and has spoken at over 150 events in 40 countries to audiences as large as 60,000. In addition, Dr. Gubler is the founder and host of “Discover with Dr. Dan: The Proactive Health Podcast,” which is ranked among the top 50 nutrition podcasts in the world. He holds a Ph.D. in organic chemistry from Colorado State University as well as a B.Sc. in biochemistry from Brigham Young University. A strong advocate for discovering and utilizing nature’s health secrets along with new compounds and novel formulations that promote health, Dr. Gubler is passionate about sharing actionable scientific information within the direct selling channel to improve individual health and transform quality of life for people around the world.

board.name: Dr. James B. Baker
board.role: DO, FACOI | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Dr. James Baker practices internal medicine at his preventive, wellness-based practice, Platinum Health & Wellness, in NW Arkansas. He has a proactive approach to patient care, with a focus on cardiovascular health, inspired by the fact that his own family has a history of cardiovascular disease, which is still the leading cause of death in this country.

With an undergraduate degree in chemistry, Dr. Baker worked as an analytical chemist prior to attending medical school. He received the “Regents Most Outstanding Graduate” award from Oklahoma State University College of Osteopathic Medicine & Surgery. He’s practiced in critical care as a hospitalist and in rehab facilities and as a hospice physician, giving him an extensive background in a variety of patient care settings. He is board certified, a Fellow of the American College of Osteopathic Internists, and was part of the founding board of directors for the Arkansas College of Health Education. As a part of the clinical faculty, Dr. Baker hosts third and fourth year medical students rotating with him in his clinic, giving him the opportunity to impact future generations of physicians. He’s also spoken nationally for numerous pharmaceutical companies. Dr. Baker is married to the love of his life, Alisa, with 5 children & 4 grandchildren. A die hard Elvis fan, Dr. Baker loves travel and adventure, has earned a black belt in 2 forms of martial arts, and feels both honored and grateful to be a member of the THREE Scientific Advisory Board.

board.name: Dr. Jessica Bordon
board.role: DPM, PA | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Dr. Jessica Bordon is a practicing podiatrist specializing in prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of foot and ankle ailments. A member of both the American Podiatric Medical Association and the American College of Foot and Ankle Surgeons, Dr. Bordon particularly enjoys treating sports medicine injuries and has a passion for improving people’s overall health and well-being. Her desire is to be able to offer a variety of services to her patients that will help them become pain free, lose weight, feel great, and achieve optimal health. The recipient of the 2020 Award for Top Podiatrist in New Braunfels, Texas, Dr. Bordon has established a reputation in her community for her expert knowledge of the highest quality products and services in natural care and is regularly consulted by medical and health & wellness professionals.
Dr. Bordon graduated Cum Laude from Texas A&M in 2000 and at the top of her class in 2006 from Temple University School of Podiatric Medicine.

board.name: Dr. Lana Louie A. Wania-Galicia
board.role: MD | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Dr. Lana Louie A. Wania-Galicia is currently the Chief Medical Officer at the Arroyo Vista Advanced Pain Specialists, Inc. in Moorpark, CA., as well as a Pain Management Consultant for the Conejo Pain Medical Group located in Thousand Oaks, CA. Dr. Wania-Galicia has received numerous awards for her work and service. These include the “Excellence in Medicine and Outreach” award from the Filipino American Association of Southern California, the “Most Outstanding Filipino American in the USA” award from the Philippine Children’s Charities, and the “Most Outstanding Teacher of the Year” award from UC Davis Pain Center, which she has won twice. Her extensive research has been published in several medical journals, and her expertise has been used by a host of organizations that have had her present and lecture to other healthcare professionals around the country.
Dr. Wania-Galicia earned her Doctor of Medicine, as well as her Bachelor of Science in Biology, at the University of Santo Tomas in her native Phillipines.

board.name: Dr. Charles Greene
board.role: MD, Ph.D | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Charles Greene, MD, PhD, is a board-certified otolaryngologist-head and neck surgeon at Jacksonville ENT Surgery. Dr. Greene earned his Bachelor of Science in biological sciences at the University of California, Irvine (UCI). He enrolled in the University of Washington School of Medicine in Seattle and was admitted into the very competitive Medical Scientist Training Program working simultaneously on his MD and PhD degrees in physiology and biophysics with an emphasis in neurophysiology. After graduating, Dr. Greene received his residency training in general surgery and otolaryngology-head and neck surgery at the University of Michigan. While there, his research led to the discovery of a novel hearing loss gene (locus), DFNA-25, and that work is published in the 2001 edition of the American Journal of Human Genetics. Dr. Greene's combination of scientific thinking, commitment to the community, and training under the guidance of world-renowned mentors has helped him develop into an outstanding clinician. If asked what he values most about patient care, he will say it is knowing that he did his very best to meet the emotional and physical needs of every patient.

board.name: Professor Sastia Putri
board.role: Ph.D. | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Sastia Putri is an Associate Professor at the Department of Biotechnology, Graduate School of Engineering, Osaka University. She received her B.Sc. degree in 2004 from Bandung Institute of Technology, Indonesia, and her M.Eng. and Ph.D. degrees in 2008 and 2010, respectively, from Osaka University. Her research focuses on the application of metabolomics in food science and microbiology. Sastia has received numerous accolades for her work, including the L’Oréal Award for Women in Science in 2015 for her research on coffee metabolomics, the Osaka University Award in 2018, the Metabolomics Society President’s Award in 2020, the Saito Award in 2022 from the Society for Biotechnology Japan, and the Momofuku Ando Prize in 2024. In addition to her academic achievements, Sastia co-founded PT. Arumia Kharisma Indonesia, which pioneers the export of high-value commodities such as tempeh and tropical fruits from Indonesia to Japan. She also established the Bright Squad community in 2023 to promote proactive wellness.

board.name: Dr. Stephen R. Sabo
board.role: MD | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Dr. Stephen R. Sabo is currently an Attending Emergency Physician in the Emergency Department at Good Samaritan Regional Medical Center in Suffern, NY, where he also teaches as an Assistant Professor of Emergency Medicine. He has spent time as reviewer for the American Board of Internal Medicine Examination, as well as Commissioner for the Northwest Bergen Regional Health Commission in Bergen County, New Jersey. Dr. Sabo has also served as the Vice President and President of the Upper Saddle River Board of Health in New Jersey.

Dr. Sabo graduated in medicine at the Chicago Medical School, but also spent time studying in Lille, France, at the Faculte Libre de Medecine. His postgraduate study took him to the Mount Sinai School of Medicine in New York where he completed his residency in Emergency Medicine. In addition, he completed a residency in Internal Medicine at the Beth Israel Medical Center in New York. Prior to studying medicine, Dr. Sabo earned his Bachelor of Arts from Brandeis University in Waltham, MA.

board.name: Dr. Naoko Yoshimura
board.role: MD | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Dr. Naoko Yoshimura enjoys enhancing people’s natural ability to heal through traditional and alternative medicine. A graduate of Kochi Medical School in Kochi Prefecture, on the island of Shikoku, Japan, Dr. Yoshimura served in the school’s Department of Radiology before obtaining her doctorate in medicine in 1997. She has practiced internal medicine and rehabilitation at Atago Hospital, Tonan Hospital, and Hisa Hospital, where she served as a member of the Nutrition Support Team. Since 2010, Dr. Yoshimura has been the Director at Medical Corp Shikoukai Shin-honmachi Clinic. She loves Three products and playing tennis.

board.name: Dr. Deirdre Leake
board.role: MD | THREE Scientific Advisory Board Member
bio: Dr. Deirdre Leake is a double board-certified facial plastic surgeon specializing in Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery and Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery. She earned her medical degree from the University of Tennessee and completed her residency at the University of Rochester Medical Center, followed by advanced fellowship training at the University of Michigan Medical Center. Since 2004, Dr. Leake has served as the Founder and Medical Director of The Facial Rejuvenation Centre and Surgery Suite in St. Augustine, Florida. She holds leadership roles within the American Academy of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery and serves on the American Board of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery’s National Board of Examiners. In 2019, she was appointed to the ABFPRS Board of Directors. Dr. Leake is excited to join THREE’s Scientific Advisory Board, where she brings her extensive clinical expertise and passion for aesthetic and wellness innovation.
